title: Diagnosis of multiple sclerosis using optical coherence tomography supported by explainable artificial intelligence
summary: Explainable learning diagnosed multiple sclerosis from OCT features with reported sensitivity and specificity. The result is limited to this study and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.

evidence.tested: The source's Methods/Results confirm the case-specific finding: Explainable learning diagnosed multiple sclerosis from OCT features with reported sensitivity and specificity.
evidence.unknown: The source-checked evidence does not establish broader external validity or prospective benefit. Affiliation was not available in the retrieved trusted primary metadata.
evidence.ai_role: Support-vector-machine recursive feature elimination with leave-one-out cross-validation selected OCT retinal-layer features for distinguishing relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis from healthy controls.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
